♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0 DO GO! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, AutoCaptions kple **Your script** kpakple **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe**, eye **Flex Studio (Beta)** gbã wɔa download, emegbe wòbiaa wò hafi ɖonɛ ɖe kɔmpiuta dzi.

*(Ɖoe ɖe wò version si li fifia dzi, eye nàgaʋu After Effects zi ɖeka.)*

♦️ **Yeye: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* **Map desk** ƒe ɖoɖo, nɔƒewo didi si mehiã internet o, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route kple bubuwo), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, anyigbatata ƒe nɔnɔme siwo nye femaxee, kple **Open in Flex Maps**.
* Eƒe dɔwɔnu bubuwo (ɖekawɔwɔ le enumake, nɔnɔmewo, ŋkɔwo, 3D, Finalize) ʋuna vavã le After Effects me azɔ.

♦️ **Nu yeyewo le AutoCaptions me**
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (lilikpo me, ezãa Flex AI credits) enye mɔ̃ si míeɖo aɖaŋu na, eye míetiae zi ɖeka na amesiame. Gatia Whisper ne èdi be yeaŋlɔ captions femaxee le wò kɔmpiuta dzi (Translate To hiã Whisper). Ne server la xɔ dɔ fũ la, eɖenɛ fiana afi si nèle le fli me.
* **Your script**: captions la xɔa wò script ƒe nyaŋɔŋlɔ kple nyawo le afi sia afi si nègblɔ nya mawo le.
* **Editable template** ƒe dodo: captions va abe template layers siwo ƒe nɔnɔme nàte ŋu atrɔ le Essential Properties me ene (After Effects 2026).
* Mètia naneke o eye Source media le ƒuƒlu? Etsɔa **composition blibo la** naa wò. Audio ma ke gazãa eƒe transcript si li xoxo.

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** gbã wɔa download, emegbe ebiana **Install / Not now**.
* App la (2.0.0-beta.2): **PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING** dɔwɔƒewo, dɔwɔnu ƒe safuiwo abe After Effects tɔ ene, clips ʋuna enumake, eye OPEN wɔa dɔ le precomps kple adjustment layers dzi.

♦️ **Nusiwo míeɖɔ ɖo**
* Theme effects siwo bú le Windows PC geɖe dzi la gbugbɔ va (wole bɔbɔe wu ne wotsi Windows ƒe animation effects).

♦️ **Nɔƒe si nàna ne èlɔ̃ hena wò license ŋudzɔdzɔ**
* Míebiana zi ɖeka ko, eye wò ŋutɔ ƒe tiatia wònye: ne èɖe **No thanks** gɔ̃ hã la, nuwo katã gawɔa dɔ ko. Àte ŋu atrɔe le **Flex Settings > Privacy** me. Míeléa ɖe asi ɣleti 12, míedzrana gbeɖe o, eye míemaa na ame aɖeke gbeɖe o, negbe ne se bia.

ult.message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0 DO GO! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Caption Stack ge ɖe AutoCaptions me** kple nya ɖesiaɖe ƒe nɔnɔme, ɖoɖowo, ʋuʋu kple gbeɖiɖiwo. **UN-NEST** kple blend modes wɔa dɔ le Premiere 26.5 dzi, **AUTO CUT** nye zizi ɖeka ko, eye **Flex Studio (Beta)** ʋua wò clip tso panel la me tẽ.

*(Ɖoe ɖe wò version si li fifia dzi, eye nàgaʋu Premiere Pro zi ɖeka.)*

♦️ **Yeye: Captions siwo ʋuʋuna le AutoCaptions me**
* **Nya ƒe nɔnɔme**: na nya sia nya eya ŋutɔ ƒe amadede, font kple Flat, Shine alo Glow ƒe nuwuwu.
* **Fli ƒe ɖoɖowo**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside kple Line.
* **Ʋuʋu na nya ɖesiaɖe** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake kple bubuwo) kple ŋgɔkpɔkpɔ, kpakple **Pop / Tick / Swoosh** gbeɖiɖiwo. Nya ƒe nɔnɔmewo kple ʋuʋu hiã **Images** ƒe dodo.
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (lilikpo me, ezãa Flex AI credits) enye mɔ̃ si míeɖo aɖaŋu na azɔ, eye míetiae zi ɖeka na amesiame; tia Whisper mɔ̃ aɖe ne èdi be yeaŋlɔ captions femaxee esime internet meli o.
* **Your script** (Captions mode): captions la xɔa wò script ƒe nyawo le afi si nègblɔ nya mawo le.
* Ne mètia naneke o (Source card le ƒuƒlu) la, etsɔa **timeline blibo la** naa wò; wodzraa captions ɖo ɖe wò project gbɔ.

♦️ **Yeye: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Open in Flex Studio** dzea clip la yome le app la me; **APPLY TO PREMIERE** gbugbɔa track la ɖona. Mèɖoe haɖe o? **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** wɔa eƒe download, emegbe ebiana **Install / Not now**.

♦️ **Nusiwo trɔ**
* **AUTO CUT** dzraa clip si nètia la me kpɔna eye wòlãnɛ le zizi ɖeka me. **Retakes** léa nyagbe siwo wogadze egɔme.
* **Audio Studio** nye sub-tab ade azɔ. **Library** le Nest Saver me azɔ.

♦️ **Nusiwo míeɖɔ ɖo**
* **UN-NEST** le Premiere 26.5 dzi (egbea nest ɖesiaɖe), kple blend modes abe Screen ene siwo trɔna yina Normal (Premiere le Eŋlisigbe me).
* **AUTOSAVE 0:00** chip dzẽ la, Caption Stack ƒe ŋgɔkpɔkpɔ yibɔ la, kple theme effects siwo bú le Windows PC geɖe dzi.

♦️ **Nɔƒe si nàna ne èlɔ̃ hena wò license ŋudzɔdzɔ**
* Míebiana zi ɖeka ko, eye wò ŋutɔ ƒe tiatia wònye: ne èɖe **No thanks** gɔ̃ hã la, nuwo katã gawɔa dɔ ko. Àte ŋu atrɔe le **Flex Settings > Privacy** me. Míeléa ɖe asi ɣleti 12, míedzrana gbeɖe o, eye míemaa na ame aɖeke gbeɖe o, negbe ne se bia.
